Quick technical notes from my side — high level only so we can keep the auditor happy without overcommitting:

- Entropy provenance: recommend using HSM-provided TRNG with attestation (device cert + nonce challenge). For any software-derived seeds, record a signed proof-of-sample (sha256 digest + timestamp) into the evidence bundle.

- Key hierarchy: keep a short-lived wrapping key (rotated daily to weekly) that wraps long-lived master key material stored only in HSM. This allows safe BYOK import with sealed wrapping.

- KDF/Derivation: use HKDF-SHA256 with per-tenant salt derived from tenant-id + signed timestamp. Include KDF params in the evidence manifest.

- Rotation windows: to meet <5m token-issuance impact, use a rolling per-node cache invalidation plus ephemeral token grace window (90s) and pre-warm KV cache during canary. We can describe an automated rolling rotation that avoids a full cluster restart.

Link to quick reference doc: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/PROD-KMS-CHECKLIST (see "entropy-provenance.md"). Ticketed follow-up: JIRA-KEY INFRA-1427.

Jonas Weber

Subject: Final design summary and next steps: entropy provenance + rotation schedule

Clara — thanks for the discussion today. Summary and agreed actions below (incorporates Jonas and Kim's points):

Summary decisions:
- Entropy provenance: Financier will use on-HSM TRNG attestations for master key generation. We will include an attestation nonce challenge in the evidence bundle and store signed digest proofs in the audit artifact.
- BYOK: support for encrypted BYOK imports using a short-lived wrapping key; import procedure documented in the runbook.
- Operator separation: require 2-person quorum for key unseal and a dedicated HSM operator role distinct from KMS admin (see attached checklist).
- Rotation schedule (agreed): phased rollout — canary (1 zone) -> staged (2 more zones over 48h) -> full. Master keys: 365d, Derivation keys: 90d, Ephemeral wrapping keys: 7d (auto-rotate). Ephemeral tokens will use a 90s grace window. This schedule is documented in rotation-schedule.xlsx.

Operational notes / constraints:
- We will not require additional HSMs in the next 30 days; design supports single-HSM-per-region fallback with careful scheduling of the canary to avoid overlaps.
- Pre-warm: minimal temporary CPU/RAM for cache pre-warm; no GPUs required.
- Custodians: Clara Huang (Financier Ops) + 2 named witnesses from your security team. Please provide final names and roles by 6/30 so we can include them in the ceremony plan.

Next steps (owners):
- Redwood: update design note and evidence manifest (Marissa) — due 6/28.
- Security checklist: Kim to finalize HSM-operator-checklist (Kimberly) — due 6/27.
- Infra runbook: Jonas to add KDF params and rotation playbook steps (Jonas) — due 6/28.
- Financier: provide custodian names and confirm maintenance window (Clara) — due 6/30.

Attachments included with this email: entropy-analysis.csv (sample entropy digests), rotation-schedule.xlsx (agreed), HSM-operator-checklist.pdf (ops acceptance), uptime_sla_requirements.docx (from Financier).

I'll package these into the audit binder and send a version for your records once Kim and Jonas have their final edits. If that works, we'll schedule the first ceremony rehearsal on 7/06.
